title: China-to-Bosnia and Herzegovina Solar PV Inverter Compliance Gap Matrix
target_market: Bosnia and Herzegovina (BAS / DERK / NOS BiH)
provenance: AI-compiled, multi-model cross-checked, not human-verified. Informational only; confirm with the official regulator and a qualified professional. Not legal/certification/customs/market-access advice.

rows.target_requirement: Solar PV inverters for Bosnia and Herzegovina should be configured and documented for the local 230/400 V 50 Hz low-voltage profile, with protection thresholds and permissible ranges validated per project, operator, and connection-point settings. Although both China and Bosnia use 50 Hz, Bosnian projects commonly differ from Chinese nominal profiles and interconnection documents should reflect Bosnia-specific voltage windows and DERK/NOS BiH expectations.
target_standards: EN 50160 voltage characteristics of electricity supplied by public distribution networks
Bosnia and Herzegovina project-specific interconnection settings
rows.china_equivalent: China inverter defaults are commonly built around domestic 50 Hz grid operation and China grid-code profiles, including GB/T 37408 and GB/T 19964. The shared frequency does not eliminate the need to check Bosnia-specific voltage windows, protection parameters, neutral/earthing assumptions, and project commissioning settings.
rows.gap: The gap is not nominal frequency alone. Exporters should provide Bosnia-specific grid-profile settings, allowable voltage/frequency ranges, over/under-voltage and over/under-frequency trip settings, reconnection delays, power-factor/reactive-power controls, and commissioning evidence for each firmware release.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory where project interconnection or commissioning in Bosnia requires grid-profile and protection settings under DERK/NOS BiH review
mandatory_status.cn: Not equivalent — China nominal 50 Hz settings do not automatically satisfy Bosnia voltage/frequency and protection requirements

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Even with 50 Hz, verify Bosnia 230/400 V settings and protection logic in the exact BOS context before energization, especially for projects with any Croatia corridor interconnection path.

source.publisher: Independent System Operator of Bosnia and Herzegovina (NOS BiH)

rows.requirement: DERK and NOS BiH Project Grid-Connection Review
rows.target_requirement: Bosnian solar projects are reviewed by DERK and NOS BiH according to project category, project route, and connection agreement. Grid-connection acceptance is separate from product test certificates and covers protection settings, remote dispatch interface, metering architecture, operation model, and project commissioning for local and cross-border-linked assets via the Ploče corridor.
target_standards: Bosnia and Herzegovina electricity market and unlicensed generation implementation references
DERK interconnection and project participation framework
NOS BiH project connection and acceptance practice
rows.china_equivalent: China State Grid and China Southern Power Grid documentation, together with GB/T 19964-2024 and GB/T 37408, can support technical comparison, but Bosnian grid acceptance remains dependent on local DERK and NOS BiH routes.
china_standards: China State Grid and China Southern Power Grid project procedures
rows.gap: For Bosnia, the gap is project acceptance. Exporters should prepare single-line diagrams, inverter model certificates, protection tables, grid-code parameter ranges, reactive-power capability, remote control evidence, meter and communication compatibility, commissioning records, and local-language operation documents for the project owner and NOS BiH.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory for projects that seek Bosnia and Herzegovina grid connection through DERK and NOS BiH; acceptance is project- and operator-specific
mandatory_status.cn: Not equivalent — Chinese grid approval does not transfer to Bosnia DERK/NOS BiH connection approval

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Treat Bosnia grid connection as a project-based approval path separate from product certificates. China GB/T project files should be mapped to DERK/NOS BiH requirements before claim-ready.

source.publisher: State Electricity Regulatory Commission (DERK) and Independent System Operator (NOS BiH)

rows.requirement: EN/IEC Safety Evidence for PV Inverters
rows.target_requirement: Bosnia and Herzegovina uses CE-oriented implementation references for in-scope electrical safety. For PV inverter safety, EN 62109-1 and EN 62109-2 evidence is commonly the relevant product-safety baseline, while legal consequence depends on the applicable Bosnia market framework, customer tender, utility list, and project approval route through DERK and NOS BiH.
rows.china_equivalent: China inverter documentation may include GB/T 37408 and GB/T 19964 evidence, plus voluntary CGC/CQC or IEC reports. GB/T performance evidence does not by itself prove conformity to full EN 62109 safety construction, thermal limits, insulation, marking, and abnormal-operation requirements in Bosnia-facing reviews.
china_standards: Voluntary CQC / CGC / IEC test reports where available
rows.gap: The gap is whether the safety file is built around EN/IEC 62109 and accepted for the Bosnia route. Exporters should prepare test reports, critical component list, isolation design evidence, thermal derating data, DC input limits, fault test evidence, local warning labeling, and nameplate data aligned to the exact model family.

mandatory_status.target: Mandatory as evidence where the target project and procurement route require EN/IEC 62109 safety support
mandatory_status.cn: Not equivalent — China GB/T inverter evidence does not automatically satisfy EN 62109 safety evidence

rows.verdict: [INFORMATIONAL] Prepare Bosnia-facing EN/IEC safety evidence instead of relying only on China GB/T documentation, and align it to the exact BOS model, route, and project scope before claiming market-readiness.

source.publisher: BAS and electricity market stakeholders in Bosnia and Herzegovina
